sources.title: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-Year Estimates, table-based Summary File
sources.access: Download from https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/summary_file/2024/table-based-SF/: one pipe-delimited file per table (data/5YRData/acsdt5y2024-TABLE.dat), and the geography file and table shells (documentation/). No key or login is needed. fetch_raw.py downloads them and checks each file's SHA-256 against SOURCES.md, and each recipe checks the files it reads again before reading them.
sources.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates.

recipes.name: acs_geographies
recipes.description: Every geography the shared ACS 2020-2024 5-year views cover (the nation, states, counties and census tracts), with its name and FIPS codes.

steps.name: keep_levels
steps.description: Check the geography file's SHA-256, then keep the whole-area rows (geographic component 00) of the nation, states, counties and census tracts from it, with each geography's name, level and FIPS codes.

recipes.name: acs_tables
recipes.description: Tidy ACS 2020-2024 5-year tables: one row per geography and variable, with its estimate, margin of error, and a note where Census reports a special value.

steps.name: reshape_long
steps.description: Check each table file's SHA-256, then reshape it (one column per estimate and per margin of error) into one row per geography and variable, with the estimate and margin of error side by side, still as Census wrote them.

steps.name: decode_annotations
steps.description: Turn Census's special values (such as -666666666) into nulls with a note, following Census's "Notes on ACS Estimate and Annotation Values", and make every estimate and margin of error a number.

steps.name: keep_geographies
steps.description: Keep only the geographies in the shared geographies view, check that every one of them has every variable exactly once, and write one view per table.

recipes.name: acs_variables
recipes.description: What every ACS 2020-2024 5-year variable means: its table, label, title and universe, from the Census table shells.

steps.name: tidy_table_shells
steps.description: Check the table shells' SHA-256, then keep one row per ACS variable (such as B19013_001) from them, with its table, position, label, title, universe and type, and drop the heading rows that have no variable.
